generalCriterionList.description: The bidder shall not be a JV company

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

technicalCriterionList.description: Executed in any one year the following minimum quantities of work (Cement Concrete - xxxx cum, Earthwork - xxxx cum, etc) (80% of peak rate of construction)

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid Electrical License for executing building electrificatio works and should have executed similar electrical works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year

Tenderer or his identified Sub Contractor should possess valid license for executing water supply / sanitary engineering works  and should have executed similar works totallng Rs. xxxxxx (not less than 50% of electrical works) n any one year
Owning the following key and critical equipment for this work (xxxx, xxxx, xxxx)
Liquid assets and /or availability of credit facilities of no less than Rs. xxxxxx Lakhs (estimated cash flow for 3 months of peak construction period)
Total value of civl engineering works executed and payments received in the last five years (year-wise)
List of existing commitments and ongoing works
List of works for which tenders already submitted
Construction equipment owned by the tenderer and equipment proposed to be deployed on this contract, if awarded
Reports on the financial standing of the tenderer, such as profit and loss statements and auditor’s reports for the last five years
List of Financial Resources with Certificates

The intending bidder shall have executed similar work/s of value not less than Rs.1,55,35,661/- (Rupees One Crore Fifty Five Lakh Thirty Five Thousand Six Hundred and Sixty One Only) (limited to maximum five work/job orders) in Retrofitting/Erection /Testing & Commissioning of BAJAJ INDEF/SWIFT/BRADY & MORRIS/REVA/KONE CRANES/S CRANES/Electro Mech make hoist in any industry, or in any PSU/IPP, during any one year in the preceding five years (2021-22 to 2025-26). As a proof of same, agency shall upload Purchase/Work Order copy, along with a corresponding completion/performance certificate issued by the rank of General Manager/Chief Engineer/Head of the client organization or by any competent authority

The intending bidder shall be an OEM/authorized dealer/authorized service provider of BAJAJ INDEF/SWIFT/BRADY & MORRIS/REVA/KONE CRANES/S CRANES/Electro Mech make. As a proof of same, the bidder shall submit the manufacturing/dealership/authorization certificate, or PO/WO copy(ies) of BAJAJ INDEF/SWIFT/BRADY&MORRIS/REVA/KONE CRANES/S CRANES/ Electro Mech make erected/commissioned/retrofitted for hoist works

The bidder shall have a minimum Annual Turnover of not less than Rs. 3,88,39,150/- (Rupees Three Crore Eighty Eight Lakhs Thirty Nine Thousand One Hundred and Fifty Only), during any two of the preceding five financial years (2021-22 to 2025-26), As a proof of same, agency shall upload Profit & Loss statement or Annual Turnover certificate duly certified by the chartered accountant. The agency shall also furnish self-attested form No. 26 AS for the particular period
